name: Tsukushi Yuzuki
source: Research institute director at the mobile company owned by Akari's parents and the protagonist's advisor. After the protagonist inherited the club, she participated in the development of new merchandise. Compact body paired with loose clothing, she is a girl with no dignity and always with a smile on her face.
